title: Keyboard Navigation
definition: Ensuring an application is fully operable using only a keyboard. This involves managing `tabindex`, maintaining logical focus order, and implementing visible focus indicators.
simpleExplanation: You must be able to use the entire website using only the 'Tab', 'Enter', and 'Arrow' keys, without ever touching a mouse.
